name: io.github.Servosity/hudu-mcp
title: Hudu MCP
description: Every Hudu cmdlet, plus an offline SQLite mirror, cross-entity audits, and agent-native output no

environmentVariables.name: HUDU_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the HUDU_API_KEY credential for the Hudu MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: HUDU_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Hudu instance's API base URL, including the /api/v1 path, e.g. https://your-subdomain.huducloud.com/api/v1 (self-hosted, *.huducloud.com, or a custom domain).

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: binds the MCP server to an existing tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. Leave unset for a single-tenant install.

environmentVariables.name: HUDU_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call.

environmentVariables.name: HUDU_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off.

environmentVariables.name: HUDU_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Hudu requests.

environmentVariables.name: HUDU_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.
